suppress.notes: Nacos server access-control and embedded Derby issues are mis-associated with the client logging adapter; this artifact contains no Nacos server or Derby endpoint.
Nacos server unauthenticated Derby management endpoint is not present in the client logging adapter.
Nacos server login access-control issue is not present in the client logging adapter.
Prometheus server remote-read Snappy allocation bug is not in Micrometer's Java registry client.
Nu Html Checker SSRF/restriction-bypass advisory is unrelated to Hibernate Validator.
Kotlin build-cache metadata deserialization is a compiler/build-cache issue; this service only receives Kotlin stdlib transitively from OkHttp and does not run the Kotlin compiler or build cache.
Kotlin 1.9.25 is newer than the affected 1.4.20 range; this is a stale CPE match on the transitive stdlib family.
The NVD match is for Tomcat's optional WebSocket chat example. The embedded core jar has no examples or chat application; the application does not package that webapp.

CVE-2025-7962 is an SMTP injection in the Angus Mail SMTP artifact (org.eclipse.angus:smtp). The dependency-check CPE is incorrectly attached to org.eclipse.angus:angus-activation:2.0.3; this jar contains only Jakarta Activation provider classes and no SMTP/mail implementation. Keep the match scoped to the exact resolved package/version so a future activation upgrade is re-evaluated.
